Question Choices: Select all that apply. Statistics involves: Collecting-data Presenting-data Analyzing-data
Hints: Think about what we do with information.
Solution: Statistics is about working with data: collecting it, organizing/presenting it, and analyzing it.

Question Choices: Which data set has more variability? A: 7, 7, 7, 7, 7     B: 2, 8, 4, 9, 1
Hints: Look at how much the numbers change.
Solution: Set A has no change → no variability. Set B has different values → high variability

Question Choices: Is this a statistical question? "How tall is my friend Alex?" Answer yes or no
Solution: Only one data point → no variability → not statistical

Question Choices: Is this a statistical question? "What is the average height of students in the class?" Answer yes or no
Hints: Do we need multiple data points?
Solution: You must collect many heights → data varies → statistical

Question Choices: Which situation has variability? A: Everyone scored 85 on a test     B: Scores are 65, 70, 80, 95, 100
Hints: Look at how much the numbers change.
Solution: A → all same → no variability. B → different → variability exists

Question Choices: Is this statistical? "Do you like pizza?" Answer yes or no
Solution: This is Yes/no vs data collection. Only one answer → no data variability

Question Choices: Is this statistical? "How many hours do students study each week?" Answer yes or no
Which is statistical? A. "What is today's temperature?"  B. "What are the temperatures this month?"
Hints: Think about number of data points
Solution: A → one value → not statistical. B → many values → variability → statistical

Question Choices: Two classes recorded homework time (in hours): Class A: 1.5, 1.7, 1.5, 1.8, 2  Class B: 1, 4, 4.5, 2.5, 3 Which class has more variability? Answer A or B
Solution: Class A → little change. Class B → numbers vary a lot → higher variability

Question Choices: Select. Change this question to a statistical question. "How many hours did I sleep last night?": How-many-hours-did-I-sleep-last-night-and-the-night-before? How-many-hours-do-students-in-my-class-sleep-each-night? Did-I-sleep-well-last-night?
Hints: A statistical question needs many data points with variability.
Solution: Original question → only one data point → not statistical. A → still about one person → very limited variability → not truly statistical. B → includes many students → answers will vary → statistical question. C → yes/no → no variability → not statistical
